Eureka Blueberries is a separate blueberry-range reference, not another blackberry or a specific denomination. This completes this article's name enumeration, not Mountain Blue's portfolio.

names.portfolio_context: Gaius Leong's Winter 2025 report describes a semi-erect, low-chill floricane blackberry. It reports mid-October–late-November harvests in Northern NSW and December–mid-January in Tasmania; these are source-specific seasonal claims, not confirmed growing regions. Reported yield exceeds 35 t/ha across multiple years; average Brix is 10–11, reaching 13. Trial design and sample sizes are not supplied. Page 83 has two photos credited to Mountain Blue, available in the linked original; reuse remains unconfirmed. The article invites licensing enquiries, without documenting a grant or licence. No match to older unnamed website selections is inferred.
